operator: Confirmed completed static/front/back/right/left handheld movement; per-action timestamps not marked
assessment: Identification/SPI reads and varying motion stream recovered; positive/negative raw counts observed at valid height. Axis direction, scale and rotation compensation NOT accepted from this test.
limitations: Telemetry is ~5Hz snapshot of faster sensor sampling, not complete integrated motion counts; cannot sum printed dx/dy to estimate centimetres.
Handheld motion includes pitch/roll changes; no pure translation segments or per-action markers guaranteed.
Ground optical quality alone does not make near-field fused velocity valid.
